theme: An open Halloween — clear the holiday-travel backlog before Toronto week.
greeting: The day's wide open, Dan: no meetings, and the girls are home for one more day before tomorrow's handoff to Jen. It's a good window to finally close the holiday-travel bookings that keep sliding past the Sunday review.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 board item has been open since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out — book it refundable now and adjust the dates once the trip firms up.

needsAttention.title: Settle the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by (Sep 30) and book-by (Oct 15) have both passed, and it's all four girls over the Dec 13–Jan 2 window — the thinnest inventory of the year. Pick domestic vs. refundable-international, then book before next week disappears.

needsAttention.title: Read ICGN's final speaker info
needsAttention.detail: Your Plenary 7 panel is in Toronto next week. Skim ICGN's final speaker and logistics email now, while the day is quiet, rather than mid-travel.
